basic_profile.bio: Avid learner and curious soul based in Portland, Oregon. I'm a software developer by day, specializing in front-end technologies, and a nature enthusiast by night. I love hiking in the beautiful Pacific Northwest. When I'm not coding or exploring trails, I'm usually diving into random topics online or participating in lively discussions. I have a keen interest in mutualistic relationships in nature and enjoy learning about new Pokemon in my downtime. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore my diverse interests. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 5 years. My expertise lies in web development, particularly in JavaScript frameworks. Outside of my career, I am self-taught in various ecological and biological topics, driven by my passion for nature.
